# E0354: the first version has a lens

A lens maps between a version and its predecessor. The first version has no
predecessor, so a lens in its file has nothing to map from.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v0_0: {
		a: "x"
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0354]: history/0.0.thema is the first version, and has no previous version to map from
 --> history/0.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: remove the lens; a lens maps between a version and its predecessor
```
